statement: Greenhouse cleaning should physically remove soil, plant debris, and other organic residues before disinfection because organic matter can reduce disinfectant effectiveness and shield pathogens from contact with the disinfectant.

review.rationale: Drafted from the reviewed UMass greenhouse cleaning/disinfection guidance and cross-checked against the current extension page on September 15, 2026. The statement preserves the distinction between physical cleaning and subsequent disinfection.
review.notes: Human sanitation/plant-pathology review is required before promotion.
